summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Digital Transformation in the Oil and Gas Industry. Equip yourself with the tools to drive innovation and efficiency.
lede: Digital transformation in oil and gas links operational technology, data, and business priorities to support better asset and operational decisions. Designed for digital leaders, operations managers, and OT specialists, this training helps prioritize initiatives and shape a practical roadmap. Participants assess digital maturity, map OT-to-IT data flows, rank use cases by value and feasibility, and plan cybersecurity controls and performance measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who sponsor, govern, design, or deliver digital transformation across upstream, midstream, downstream, and oilfield service operations. It suits experienced practitioners who can connect operational realities with technology, data, cybersecurity, and investment decisions.
audience: Oil and Gas Digital Transformation Managers
modules: Oil and Gas Digital Transformation Context
prerequisites: You should have working experience in oil and gas operations, asset management, maintenance, engineering, industrial automation, OT cybersecurity, data architecture, technology delivery, or energy leadership. Familiarity with production workflows, maintenance records, control systems, or operational reporting will help. No programming is required. Advanced AI, cloud, and cybersecurity topics receive conceptual and operational treatment, while exercises focus on use-case framing, architecture decisions, governance, and implementation planning rather than production software deployment.
